start.card:
Welcome to the game show! Behind one of three doors is a car. Behind the other two are goats.
You pick a door. The host, who knows where the car is, opens a different door with a goat. Then you may switch.
First, make a guess.
start.title: Monty Hall: Stay or Switch?
visibleButtons: Switch to the other closed door

afterGuess.card:
You guessed: "Stay with my first door". Let's test it.
Click a door to pick it.
afterGuess.title: Monty Hall: Stay or Switch?

after.card:
You picked door 1. The host opened door 3: a goat.
Two doors are still closed: your door 1 and door 2. Stay or switch?
after.title: Monty Hall: Stay or Switch?
